# Sofonias Mengistu
# https://www.sofoniasdevops.com/

> Remote DevOps Engineer, Cloud Platform Architect, Azure Data Engineer, Network Engineer, DevSecOps / SRE, and Kubernetes Consultant. CNCF Kubestronaut. Based in Addis Ababa. Delivers worldwide.

Sofonias Mengistu is a Cloud Platform Architect and Cloud DevOps engineer for hire. He takes full time roles, consulting hours ($200 USD), a monthly retainer ($3,600 for up to 20 hours), and scoped product builds. First 15 minutes are free. This website does not take card payments; work is invoiced.
